cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The ghost's waiting at our breakfast table. Do we have cereal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're already late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then give it the instant porridge. I'll find a bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would a dead person need feeding? I'm taking the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it in a travel cup. You can drop it at the cemetery on your way.

mechanism: A uses its pupil breakfast-service habits to redirect questions about a ghost existence into timely feeding and transport tasks.
confusable: Not protecting A hidden causal responsibility: A simply refuses why and keeps choosing the next practical step.
comparison: Feeding on a commute versus containing an impossible artwork leak.
